title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I saw a dream a week ago, before Fajr. I saw that three adult pigs and a small one were standing outside the main entrance of my house 1950 views Q. I dreamed that i saw a child sitting against a faint white wall. When I came near it, he told me he was dead. I then kissed his cheek. My sister was sitting beside me and leaned forward to embrace him but i stopped her. What does this mean? 1281 views Q. Dear Mufti Saahab, May Allah(SWT) bless you with the best for the work you are doing. Few days ago a very pious person passed away in our town. He was not a Aalim or Haafeez but a Daaiee who was involved very much in the work of Daawaah. I wasn't there in my town during that time neither was I close to this person during his hayaat but, use to see him often while going and coming from prayers. Coming to the point. I with my family and my brother-in-law were discussing about this person after which we went to sleep. I dreamt about the person who passed away that "It is a time for prayers (Don't remember which prayer but, I feel Magrib) and this person is asking me to lead the prayers and upon his saying I led the prayers and I started reciting aayaahs (Qiraat) and I remember that I was stopping after each aayaah and was very slow in recitation (Don't remember which aayaahs). This person whom I am talking about, in the state of Salaah started reading the Aayaahs louder and little faster and I taught he is prompting me and even I started reciting it fast. Please interpret this dream of mine (Jazaakumullah). 1529 views Q. اللہ کے نبی صلی اللہ اور ابراہیم علیہ السلام آے اور ابراہیم علیہ السلانے کہا کہ اب میرا دین چلے گا اور حضور صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کچھ نہیں بولے۔ 1628 views Q. فجر سے پہلے میں خواب دیکھتا ہوں کہ میری بیوی مردہ ہے لیکن میں یہ خبر ٹی وی چینل پر دیکھتا ہوں۔ براہ کرم وضاحت فرماویں۔ 1237 views Q. Use of 786 5089 views Q. Dream 1522 views Q. My wife saw a dream..... 2011 views Q. Dream 1292 views Q. Meaning of Dream 1738 views Q. دس سال پہلے میں مسلمان ہواتھا، میرے والدین کا انتقال ہوگیاہے، میرے دوست کے والدین ہی میرا خیال رکھتے تھے، وہ لوگ میرے لیے دلہن تلاش کررہے ہیں، میرے مسلمان ہونے کی وجہ سے بہت ساری لڑکیوں نے مجھے مسترد کردیاہے،میں ان پر الزام نہیں دے رہاہوں، بلکہ مجھے اتفاق ہے کہ ہر ایک کو اپنا شریک حیات چننے کا حق ہے، لیکن میری صورت حال میں سبھی لوگ ایک ہی وجہ بتاتے ہیں۔ ایک اور بات میں شیئر کرنا چاہوں گاکہ پوری دنیا میں اسلام بہت تیزی سے پھیل رہا ہے، ( اللہ کا شکرہے)۔حال ہی میں بی بی سی /سی این این (یقین نہیں ہے، بلکہ سناہے)نے اسلام کا سروے کیا تو اسلام ہی ایک ایسا مذہب ہے جو ہر سال تیزی سے پھیل رہا ہے۔ الحمد للہ۔ میں صرف یہ وجہ جاننا چاہتاہوں کہ کیوں لوگ سمجھتے ہیں کہ سارے نومسلم گناہ گار ہیں؟ اور ان کو مسترد کیا جاتاہے؟ میرا خیال ہے کہ حضرت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے علاوہ سبھی لوگ نومسلم ہیں اور اسلام میں داخل ہوئے ہیں؟اگر میں غلط کہہ رہا ہوں تو صحیح رہنمائی فرمائیں۔ 1338 views Q. I saw a dream that Allah Subhana Tala ordered me that u should work for me. you tell the right way to the people who are going on the wrong way becaue i sent u to complete my work. When u complete the work then i call u back. He said me for Tablige. What is the meaning of this dream. 1533 views Q. Dream after having Done Isthikhaara. I did isthikhaara to know whether i Had future with a particular man that i was interested in. 1391 views Q. a boy want to marry a gilr (muslim). One day i did Istekhara(with niyat that to seek what is allah's marzi n if i will be happy with him or not), on next moring i did not see any thing but felt that he is right choice. Next day when i did istekhara again, i could see one of my friend telling about that boy in dream. Next day also when i did istekhara, i again felt presence of that boy. That boy also did istekhara, he did not see me but saw many things of mine in dream (eg - a lady wearing same dress as i have, but did not see her face). i am really confused. shall i take for grant that its allah's wish?? please help me out as soon as possible Regards! 1437 views Q. Asalaamvalaikum, I saw one dream that i am at home and my mother-in-law is discussing some food itemwith my husband. I asked her but sh said nothing,as I am having some problems with her.Than, I said that i have already decided the menu. Than I saw that my father-in-law who has died a year ago was a very good and a pious man. He came with my brother-in-law to our house and he lied down on bed as he is not well and plays with my daughter who is 9months old. I went to him and said salaam but he didn't listen to it and than I went near him and said salaam than he put his hane on my head and replied and ask me how i am. Is there any meaning of this dream? 1618 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 8313 Country: AF Title: My Name is Mohammad Rasool. I saw two dreams: (1): I saw a dream that performing Tawaf and saying these words till end (لبیک لبیک لاشریکه لبیک) around the Kaba Sharif near to Fajr time. 2: In Second dream saw people saying, that person is Hazrat Mohammad (PBUH) then I went to Hazrat Mohammad (PBUH) and kiss his blessed hand, but I couldn't see his blessed face clearly. Question: Asalumu Alikum: My Name is Mohammad Rasool. I saw two dreams: (1): I saw a dream that performing Tawaf and saying these words till end (لبیک لبیک لاشریکه لبیک) around the Kaba Sharif near to Fajr time. 2: In Second dream saw people saying, that person is Hazrat Mohammad (PBUH) then I went to Hazrat Mohammad (PBUH) and kiss his blessed hand, but I couldn't see his blessed face clearly. Jazaakallahu khaira Answer ID: 8313 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1668/2084=B/1429) (1) In-sha-Allah you will be blessed with hajj. (2) You have high respect towards the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) , but you should pay attention to follow the sunnah and rectify the acts which are diverted from the sunnah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
